hypotheses.B1_weight_outliers_match_natural_bottlen: The frozen weight-outlier output-4 subspace captures at least 85% as much centered write variance as each corpus's optimal output-4 subspace.
hypotheses.B2_outlier_only_is_behaviorally_sufficie: Keeping the discovery mean plus only the weight-outlier output-4 component has median final-distribution KL at most 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B3_outliers_plus_tail16_are_near_suffici: Keeping the discovery mean, output-4 outliers, and the leading residual-tail 16-space has median KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
hypotheses.B4_outlier_removal_is_more_damaging_than: On every corpus, removing the output-4 bottleneck causes at least twice the median KL of removing the complete residual tail.
hypotheses.B5_tail16_is_cross_corpus_stable: On every corpus, the frozen FineWeb residual-tail 16-space has mean canonical cosine at least 0.70 with the native tail-16 space and captures at least 75% of its optimal variance.
hypotheses.B6_tail16_beats_norm_matched_random_edit: On every corpus, removing the native tail-16 projection causes at least twice the median KL of a residual-random edit matched per site for output norm.
hypotheses.B7_outlier_subspace_has_recurrent_next_t: At least three next-token structural categories decoded from the output-4 scores have AUROC at least 0.70 on all three evaluation corpora.
hypotheses.B8_tail_subspace_has_recurrent_next_toke: At least three next-token structural categories decoded from the residual-tail 16 scores have AUROC at least 0.70 on all three evaluation corpora.
